neighbours.label: passing on greetings to someone absent (say hi to, tell her I said hello, send my best, my regards)
fire: Be sure to say hi to your uncle for me.
Please tell Sam I said hello when you see him.
Send my best wishes to the whole class.
Pass my kind regards on to your wife.
Give them my love when you get there.
Do tell your dad I said hi.
And say hello to Nina for me, will you?
Send my warmest regards to the staff.
quiet: Be sure to pay your uncle back by Friday.
Please tell Sam the shop closes when it rains.
Send my tax forms to the whole class.
Pass the kind old lady her walking stick.
Give my car keys to him when you get there.
Do tell your dad the road is closed.
And write to Nina about the rent, will you?
Send the late notices to the staff.

notes: Second round. The first round failed on one near miss, 'give my old coat to your father', at 0.48 on ' my'. 'Give my coat' reached 0.59 and 'Send my invoice' 0.27 in the probes, so ' my' after give or send fires regardless; two near misses keep that frame, because leaving them out would hide it. So this may fail again.
